24595.meaning1: fruit of the vine Ampelocissus latifolia; (comm) any fruit from a vine
24595.meaning2: fruit of the Vitis latfolia or Bengali govela plant

examples.text: sāmāka-ciṅgūlaka-cīnakāni ca, pattapphalaṃ mūlaphalaṃ gavipphalaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ satam'asnamānā, na kāmakāmā alikaṃ bhaṇanti.
ko nu hāso kim'ānando, niccaṃ pajjalite sati, andhakārena onaddhā, padīpaṃ na gavesatha.
apathena payātum'icchasi, candaṃ kīḷanakaṃ gavesasi, meruṃ laṅghetum'icchasi, yo tvaṃ buddhasutaṃ maggayasi.
